Description:
Hi! I'm BAIREBOON.❤❤❤❤❤
This is a portrait I drew, and I only uploaded it on NexusMods.(❁´◡`❁)

How to install:

1.Download and install Portraiture
in----\steamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods

2.Download BAIREBOON Portraits.zip,
unzip BAIREBOON Portraits folder,place in the\Stardew Valley\Mods\Portraiture/Portraits folder

3.The first use, please talk to the NPC,
then press the P key on the keyboard to switch portraits.
